title: Consumer Tax Credits for EVs: Some Quasi-Experimental Evidence on Consumer Demand, Product Substitution, and Carbon Emissions
eligible_reason: Each DiD has a single policy date: South Carolina's PHEV tax-credit launch (ms_launch, ms_comscore, ms_google, ms_size, ms_border; first post month identical for all treated counties), Oregon's termination (ms_termination), and Colorado's launch (ms_co). Treated units are counties of one state, so there is one adoption cohort per design. Most columns also add time-varying controls (gasprice, price, annual ACS demographics) and model x strata FE.
design_notes: ms_submission.do: Table 2 (line 52-56) reghdfe saleln gasprice price education age income Unemployment male_pct launch, absorb(county year month model strata); Figures 1-2, 4 event studies c.treat#i.period; Table 3 border counties; Table 4 Oregon termination; Table 5 comscore (cnt, county + year + month FE, no controls) and Google Trends (state-week); Table 7 heterogeneity; Table 8 Colorado; Table 9 total sales; Table 10 fuel efficiency. Verified single first-post month per dataset in the shipped files.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: One treatment date per design (SC launch; OR termination; CO launch).
data_files_note: readme.txt: the four vehicle-transaction datasets are 'random subset of original datasets' (proprietary marketing-agency data); ACS and Google Trends inputs public.
software_notes: Stata reghdfe; 'original code.do' and ms_log.log for the full data.
